narrative: Today's tech brief highlights significant developments across various sectors, including international trade tensions impacting software development, groundbreaking AI research in biological fields, and advancements in space technology. Key infrastructure updates from AWS and Cloudflare aim to enhance performance and security, while major scientific discoveries continue to expand our understanding of the universe.
